verdict.rationale: An API reference is a fair question for a SaaS service like Atlas, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only the incorporation workflow (dashboard, signup, legal documents). It shows no Atlas API, no interactive reference and no runnable examples, and every OpenAPI probe returned 404. The general Stripe llms.txt and markdown docs pages are documentation formats, not an interactive API reference, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
